jobs.prompt: Run the Steer daily report workflow. Gather tickets, Pulse reports, worker-thread outcomes, and reports created since the previous daily interval; summarize what changed; label blockers or stale context; and write lightweight Pulse guidance. Do not perform strategy replanning unless a weekly steering job is also due. Use skills/steer-update/templates/daily-report.md as the workflow reference.

Run the Steer weekly scrum steering workflow. Gather tickets created, started, completed, blocked, or spawned since the last weekly interval; reflect on outcomes; check drift against farplane/goals.md; plan the next week; preserve the report-before-goals-mutation rule; propose goals deltas with approval gates when needed; and route executable changes to tickets or Goal Advisor handoffs. Use skills/steer-update/templates/strategy-review.md as the workflow reference.
